Population increased in Rother

The estimated population of Rother in 2024 was 96,133 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Rother's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Rother increased by 2.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Rother was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Rother

The average (median) age fell to 53.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Rother has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Rother is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Rother's population of 96,133 usual residents was made up of:

  • 14,059 people aged 0 to 15 years, (14.6%)
  • 50,808 people aged 16 to 64 years, (52.9%)
  • 31,266 people aged 65 years and over, (32.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Rother has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (32.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Rother, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Rother
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Rother, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 810 people (-0.9%). In total, there were 655 births and 1,465 deaths in Rother.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,319 (1.4%). There were 6,287 people entering the area and 4,968 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Rother's population of 534 (0.6%) as a result of 731 people entering the area and 197 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Rother was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Rother in mid-2023 is 95,089.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 172 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 55 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 227 people.
